dialogue.speaker: scp096
dialogue.text: I am SCP Zero Nine Six.

dialogue.speaker: scp096
dialogue.text: Once you see my face, nothing stops me.

dialogue.speaker: medusa
dialogue.text: One gaze turns flesh to stone.

dialogue.speaker: medusa
dialogue.text: Trespass here, and join my garden.

sentences.speaker: scp096
sentences.text: I am SCP Zero Nine Six.

sentences.speaker: scp096
sentences.text: Four pixels seal your fate.

sentences.speaker: scp096
sentences.text: Once you see my face, nothing stops me.

sentences.speaker: medusa
sentences.text: I am Medusa, cursed Gorgon.

sentences.speaker: medusa
sentences.text: One gaze turns flesh to stone.

sentences.speaker: medusa
sentences.text: Trespass here, and join my garden.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Deep in the misty ruins, Medusa guarded her silent garden of stone.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Then a deafening shriek shattered the night, and SCP Zero Nine Six smashed straight through the wall.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The intruder was already stone, yet Medusa looked straight into the monster's face.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Both curses ignited at once as the Shy Guy blurred forward like a missile.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Grey rock crept across its skin, yet the monster barely slowed, forcing Medusa into the air.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: From above, her brazen claws and venomous vipers tore deep into its pale flesh.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Shredded and bleeding, Zero Nine Six refused to fall, ripping a pillar from the earth.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: It yanked the cursed Gorgon out of the sky and slammed her into the marble floor.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Her golden wings broken, the mortal Gorgon stared death straight in the jaw.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Trapped beneath its claws, Medusa stopped dodging and poured every drop of her curse into one gaze.

sentences.speaker: medusa
sentences.text: Turn to stone!

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Emerald fire swallowed the scream, locking pale flesh into solid rock from the eyes down.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Breathing hard among the rubble, Medusa rose and studied the newest statue in her garden.

sentences.speaker: medusa
sentences.text: No beast escapes my gaze.

sentences.speaker: medusa
sentences.text: Not even you.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Yet stone can only freeze flesh — and Zero Nine Six's bones cannot be broken.

sentences.speaker: scp096_whisper
sentences.text: Four...

sentences.speaker: scp096_whisper
sentences.text: pixels...

sentences.speaker: scp096_whisper
sentences.text: left.
